description: Shared Hill-model engineering hypotheses for the articulated leg-muscle experiment. The body descriptor supplies each muscle's immutable optimal length l0; shortening speed is normalized in optimal lengths per second.

max_isometric_force_N.note: Shared 10 micronewton F_iso placeholder for every group. It is not a muscle-specific measured strength. Use force_scale for bounded sensitivity analysis.

max_shortening_velocity_optimal_lengths_.note: At the current body l0 of 180 micrometres this is 1.8 millimetres per second, preserving the pipeline's previous vmax/l0 ratio while allowing vmax to scale with l0.

biological_context.scope: Reports probe-evoked leg forces below 0.1 to 10 micronewtons per spike in the described setup.
biological_context.caveat: Probe-evoked force per spike is not isolated-muscle isometric force F_iso and is not used to fit these parameters.

biological_context.scope: Preprint reports approximately linear passive joint torques and that passive mechanics alone are insufficient for the described leg behavior.
biological_context.caveat: No ambiguous stiffness value is converted into a muscle parameter here.
